privateDeals.what: Dangote Petroleum Refinery IPO on NGX: 4.1bn new shares at N525 (~N2.15tn / ~$1.6bn); SEC approval Sept 5, prospectus Sept 7; offer opened Sept 14 and closes Oct 13, 2026; Pan-African Refinery Investment SPV pre-committed $400m
Africa Finance Corporation-structured $2.5bn private equity placement into Dangote Petroleum Refinery, reported signed Aug 13, 2026 (reported oversubscribed 3.7x)
25-year, $4.2bn natural gas supply agreement with China's GCL Group for the Ethiopia fertilizer project
$400m construction equipment agreement with XCMG to expand refinery from 650k to 1.4m bpd
Ethiopian Investment Holdings and Dangote Group sign $2.5bn deal for 3m t/yr urea plant in Gode (60/40)
Engineers India hired on ~$450m contract to manage construction of the Lamu, Kenya refinery
Dangote Group rejected NNPC request to raise its refinery stake (NNPC holds ~6.8% after paying for only part of an original 20%)

realEstate.type: Two US mansions and a UK house - sold (Dangote said he sold all foreign properties when he moved into industry; timing not given)

policy.what: Dangote Petroleum Refinery suit (FHC/L/CS/1174/2026, Federal High Court Lagos, Justice Akintayo Aluko): interim injunction barring NMDPRA from suspending product loading or sealing/shutting the Lekki Free Zone refinery; motion on notice adjourned to Sept 9, 2026
Refinery sued the Attorney-General (filed May 15, 2026) to void fuel import licences NMDPRA issued to NNPC and marketers, arguing breach of the Petroleum Industry Act and an earlier status-quo order
NMDPRA approved 830,000 tonnes of petrol imports amid the Dangote legal battle (Sept 2026)
Dangote petitioned ICPC (Dec 16, 2025) alleging corruption by NMDPRA chief Farouk Ahmed, who resigned; Dangote later filed a petition with the EFCC after withdrawing from ICPC (Jan 2026)
PENGASSAN union dispute (Sept-Oct 2025) over ~800 dismissed refinery workers; National Industrial Court restrained the strike; resolved via government-brokered deal to reabsorb staff

giving.name: Aliko Dangote Foundation N1 trillion (~$688m) 10-year education commitment; Dangote says he will leave one-third of his fortune to charity

watch.what: Dangote refinery shares expected to list on the Nigerian Exchange
Groundbreaking of Dangote-backed East Africa Oil Refinery in Lamu, Kenya (President Ruto expected)
Refinery v. NMDPRA/Attorney-General litigation over import licences and free-zone jurisdiction (Federal High Court Lagos)
Dangote Cement Q3 2026 results (Q3 2025 results came in October; H1 2026 released July 29, 2026)

gaps: No EDGAR presence (no CIK). No verified recent real estate purchases; no verified aircraft/trophy assets. Refinery ticker not yet assigned. AFC $2.5bn placement sourced only to secondary outlet. Dangote Fertiliser ownership % not verified. Aliko Dangote Foundation is Nigerian (no US EIN).
